interpretation: The empirical LOOCV residual stress is compared with the ideal QAE target; it is not a posterior discrepancy model or a new physical validation.
limitations: Residuals are resampled iid from 32 leave-one-out errors and ignore input dependence.
The 4096 states come from a Gaussian-copula surrogate prior, not direct physical PSA evaluations.
QAE statistical error, state preparation, controlled oracle, and hardware noise are not included in the stress distribution.
